default_warning_en: These are different material stages. REO is not magnet tonnage; apparent consumption is not NdFeB demand.
default_warning_zh: 不同环节不可相加；REO 不是磁体吨数；表观消费不是钕铁硼需求。
absolute_toggle: Native tonnes/rates, explicit year/quarter and actual/nameplate/planned badges. Never combine rates, product tonnes, REO-equivalent and element tonnes on one additive axis.

percent_toggle.world_mine: Country rows / source rounded 390,000 t total. Shares sum below 100% because of source rounding; show rounding note rather than fictitious extra country.

us_apparent_context.disclaimer: Algebraic context from rounded USGS figures. Not an independently observed physical import minus export ledger, not magnet demand, and not a stock/loss model. Reported reliance is 67%.

percent_toggle.scenario: Use scenario available-mass 100 t denominator, with visible stocks and explicit unknown/unallocated terms. Do not renormalize known allocations to make them fill 100%.

required_visible_labels: source versus derived versus scenario legend
controls: gross inflow / net imports / defined net inflow / outflow

map_volume_badges: Only source-native observed site/company volumes and separately tagged capacities. Actual vehicles/robots/turbines are output counts; do not convert them to magnet tonnes without an explicitly selected BOM scenario.
unknowns: Use Unknown / 未知 badges, anonymous counterparties, and unallocated bands if a quantitative denominator exists. An unknown total cannot have a numerical unknown percentage.
old_deck: The normalized prototype is an illustrative allocation. Its bands do not establish actual shipments, inventories, processing losses or an absolute-tonne conversion.
